entries.proof_and_scope: L=target*b-a, R=c-target*d. A lower-end step updates L-=kR; an upper-end step updates R-=kL. Exact representable targets return first, so the loop never divides by zero. Fraction comparison, addition/subtraction, multiplication/division, unary negation and floor determine output.

Only isolated vertices are removed when L+R>8M. Unit-capacity bipartite matching is unchanged by this removal; output maps active indices back to original endpoints. min(L,R) is a valid flow upper bound. mf_graph construction, add_edge, flow and get_edge determine output.

environment.timing: same input/compiler/IO/checks, CPU 31, 5 alternating A/B repetitions; extra matching confirmation 9 repetitions and byte-identical control; wall time including main, IO and process startup
environment.limitations: This measures whole-program main changes with identical library bodies. It does not claim library-only improvement or online AC.

rejected: O3/unroll regressed exact-fraction profiles by ~46-51%; maximum-flow O3/unroll lacked stable improvement on random/long-augment matching; retain default O2. Small matching differences are within control variation; isolated-vertex savings are robust.
